## `lr-button-group`

The host `aria-label`, the `accessibleLabel` property, and the `label` fallback name the inner role in that order.

Responsive semantic grouping primitive for related action controls. It preserves the slotted
controls and exposes `role="group"` on its internal wrapper (parts `base`, also named `button-group`).
It holds no state and handles no keys; for a row of toggles with pressed state behind one tab stop,
use `lr-toggle-group`.

**Properties:**

- `orientation: LyraOrientation = 'horizontal'` (reflected; the shared
  `'horizontal' | 'vertical'` layout axis, with no component-local alias)
- `label: string = ''` — accessible group-name fallback; a host `aria-label`, when present, wins
  including an explicitly empty value

**Slots:** default action controls.

**CSS parts:** `base` (the `role="group"` flex wrapper; wraps within its allocation).

Further CSS parts: `button-group`: Web Awesome-named alias on the same wrapper as `base`.

**Themeable custom properties:** `--lr-button-group-gap` (default `var(--lr-space-2xs)`) — gap
between slotted controls on both axes. `--lr-button-group-justify` (default `normal`) is the
`justify-content` of a horizontal group: give the host a width (for example `display: flex` or
`inline-size: 100%`) and set `space-between` or `space-evenly` to spread the buttons across it.

**Sizing.** The group derives its width from its content and wraps within a constrained
allocation. The host can shrink to fit the available space. Each control retains its own
minimum hit target and may extend past an allocation narrower than that target.
To fill a definite host width, set `lr-button-group::part(base) { inline-size: 100%; }`.
